ios.desc:
Turn reading into listening — privately.

Ghost Reader narrates PDFs, EPUBs, web articles, Markdown, and plain-text files with natural on-device voices. Import a document or paste a link, then listen while following the text in Focus mode.

  YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY WITH YOU

  Narration is generated on your iPhone. Your documents, extracted text, and audio are not sent to our servers. No account is required.

  MADE FOR LISTENING

  • Follow along with sentence highlighting and auto-scroll
  • Pick a voice and adjust listening speed from 0.5× to 2×
  • Navigate to any part of a document and resume where you stopped
  • Use lock-screen and headphone play/pause controls when narration is ready
  • Set a sleep timer or export narration as an MP3

  FREE TO START

  Enjoy 30 minutes of narration each day for free. Upgrade through the App Store for unlimited listening with Monthly or Lifetime Access.

  Requires iPhone 12 or newer.

  Privacy Policy: https://bighippolabs.com/page-ghostreader/privacy.html
  Terms of Use: https://bighippolabs.com/page-ghostreader/terms.html
